title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Publication of Announcements in the Public Summons Procedure by People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issues Concerning the Publication of Announcements in Public Summons Procedures

Fa [2016] No. 109

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and all units of this Court:

In order to effectively regulate the publication of announcements in public summons procedures and to address the issues of non-unified and non-standardized platforms for publishing announcements concerning risk bills, the following notice is hereby given:

In accordance with Article 219 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 448 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Further Standardizing the Work of Publishing Court Announcements, and other documents, when a people's court publishes an announcement after accepting an application for public summons, it shall do so in the People's Court Daily. The electronic edition of the People's Court Daily and China Court Website shall simultaneously publish the announcement free of charge.

It is hereby notified.

April 11, 2016
